title: Complete cooling before moving the object to its final destination
description: Use this when a task requires both cooling an object and placing it somewhere.
content: After picking up the object, go to the open fridge and use the cool action with the fridge. Once cooling is confirmed, navigate to the target cabinet, open it, and then move the object into it.

title: Locate the target object before attempting to pick it up
description: Use this when an object needs to be picked up but the take action fails repeatedly.
content: If a take action returns "Nothing happens," verify you are in the same location as the object by navigating to the object's container first. Only attempt to take the object after the observation confirms it is visible at your current location.

source.task_query: Your task is to: cool some mug and put it in cabinet.

title: Move objects to a destination only after arriving at that location
description: Use when an object needs to be placed at a specific location and the move action fails from a distance.
content: If a move action does not work while standing elsewhere, first go to the destination location. Then perform the move action to successfully place the object there.

title: Open closed cabinets before placing items inside
description: Use this when the destination container is closed and needs to receive an object.
content: Before moving an object into a cabinet, check whether the cabinet is closed and open it if necessary. Once the cabinet is open, use the move action to place the object inside.

title: Search multiple plausible locations for target objects before giving up
description: Use this when collecting multiple instances of an object and the first obvious location does not contain all needed items.
content: When searching for multiple instances of an object, check all plausible surfaces and containers in the area rather than repeatedly revisiting the same empty location. title: Heat objects with the microwave by placing them inside first
description: Use this when a task requires heating an object and a microwave is available.
content: To heat an object in the microwave, first open the microwave, move the object into it, and then use the heat action; attempting to heat while the object is not inside the microwave will fail.

title: Locate target objects on countertops rather than inside closed storage
description: Use this when searching for small food items like eggs that are not found in cabinets or drawers.
content: When a target object is not found in cabinets or drawers, check countertops and other open surfaces. Eggs and similar food items are often placed on countertops where they are directly visible and can be picked up without opening containers.

title: Cool objects using a fridge before placing them
description: Use when a task requires cooling an object, such as a pan, before moving it to a destination.
content: To cool an object, first take it to a fridge and use the cool action with the fridge. After cooling is confirmed, proceed to place the object at the required destination.

title: Open the fridge before moving items into it
description: Use this when the task requires putting an item into a fridge or other closed container.
content: Before moving an item into a fridge, first go to the fridge and open it. Once the fridge is open, use the move action to place the item inside.

description: Use this after successfully heating an object and when the task specifies a final location.

title: Transport items one at a time to the destination
description: Use this when moving multiple objects to a target container.
content: Pick up one object, navigate to the destination container, and place it inside before returning for the next object. Attempting to pick up a second object while already holding one will fail.
